_carry: What you can carry of each ammo type, in stacks (the stack sizes below): stacks with the white backpack, and perPack more for each tier above it. Ours, after Apex's inventory: there was no limit, so the walk-over pickup took every matching stack on the map and a player finished a match with 2,000 rounds; the limit is what makes a backpack worth having and ammo a choice.
_note: Ammo, Season 30 (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md section 8): each gun's type, the inventory stack per type, and the energy rework: energy guns carry their own stockpile of whole magazines that refills one magazine every 18 s while the gun is idle (not firing or reloading). The range is unlimited unless Settings says otherwise; a match counts.
_kit: what a 1v1 or bot match gives you each life: this many stacks of each gun's ammo (ours; Apex's Mixtape gives unlimited reserves)
